description: This file contains utility functions for distributed training in PyTorch, including creating TCP stores, obtaining free network ports, and managing socket connections, with a focus on distributed process coordination.

methods.name: create_c10d_store
methods.description: Creates and returns a TCP store for distributed training, with optional retries and port selection.

methods.name: _check_full_rank
methods.description: Checks if all distributed processes have joined by using a barrier, raises TimeoutError if timeout occurs.

methods.name: get_free_port
methods.description: Finds and returns an unused network port on localhost.

methods.name: get_socket_with_port
methods.description: Creates and returns a socket bound to a free port on localhost, which can be used to reserve a port temporarily.
